tools.name: Device Bridge
tools.summary: Watch and drive an iOS simulator or Android device from a browser, over one forwarded port.

targets.name: iOS simulator
targets.summary: The booted simulator, streamed as H.264 and driven over idb.

linux.note: iOS simulators are a macOS framework (CoreSimulator); no Linux build exists.

windows.note: iOS simulators are a macOS framework (CoreSimulator); no Windows build exists.

targets.name: Android device or emulator
targets.summary: Any adb-visible device or emulator, streamed through scrcpy's server.

windows.note: The code paths exist — stdlib only, CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP instead of setsid, and the server jar is found beside scrcpy.exe — but this has not been run on Windows. Use devicebridge.cmd; install.sh needs WSL or Git Bash.
